threads.body: [Testing] New RPC exception event extractor helpers don’t appear to have any unit tests. Since this sets user-visible log event names/severities under `otel.semconv.exception.signal.preview=logs`, it would be good to add a small test (similar to `InstrumenterTest.server_error/client_error`) that builds an instrumenter with `setRpc*ExceptionEventExtractor(...)` and asserts the emitted `LogRecordData` has the expected `eventName` (e.g., `rpc.server.call.exception`) and `Severity` when `emitExceptionAsLogs()` is true.

replies.body: Added `RpcExceptionEventExtractorsTest` in `instrumentation-api-incubator` (runs under the `testExceptionSignalLogs` task with `otel.semconv.exception.signal.preview=logs`) that builds an instrumenter with `setRpcServer/ClientExceptionEventExtractor(...)` and asserts the emitted `LogRecordData` has the expected event name (`rpc.server.call.exception` / `rpc.client.call.exception`), `Severity`, and exception attributes when `emitExceptionAsLogs()` is true (and no log when false). Also made the gRPC error tests (`AbstractGrpcTest`) mode-aware as an integration check, with a per-module `testExceptionSignalLogs` Gradle task.
